messages:
maria_support: Hey team, LuminaPay on prod is hitting repeated 429s nightly at ~00:00 UTC. Customer reports success rate drop from ~99% to ~70% for a 7–10m window. They see an RPM jump: baseline ~220 -> spike ~1.8k. Latency is normal, errors are 429 only.

sam_sre: Thanks — can you paste a short log sample and their client behavior (cron, batch size, concurrency)? Also which region/tier are they on?

maria_support: Logs from their payload window (redacted):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-15T00:01:12Z","tenant":"lumina","path":"/v1/generate","status":429,"rpm":1812,"tpm":950}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T00:02:05Z","tenant":"lumina","path":"/v1/embeddings","status":200,"lat_ms":120}
```
They run a nightly batch that fans out 1k small requests over 2 minutes, coming from a few ephemeral API keys. Region: us-west. Tier: hosted standard.

sam_sre: Sounds like a classic minute-boundary fanout. Two things to check from infra side: per-tenant quota windows and ratecap backpressure logs. Run: 
```
curl -s "https://ops.internal/api/ratecaps?tenant=lumina&window=60" | jq .summary
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=edge-proxy --since=15m | grep "tenant=lumina" | head -n 20
```
Also confirm whether our gateway is enforcing a rolling-window token-bucket or strict per-minute buckets — rolling helps smoothing.

alex_dev: I pulled their request headers from the example trace. They don't send Retry-After and their client retries immediately with same parallelism. They fan out from 5 containers x 200 parallel each briefly. Suggest client-side: add jittered exponential backoff + limit concurrency to ~50 per container at midnight.

jenny_prod: For a quick mitigation we can: 1) enable tenant smoothing (config flag) which converts per-minute buckets to a 10s sliding window for LuminaPay, 2) apply a temporary RPM bump while they roll out client fixes. I can apply the config if SRE gives thumbs.

sam_sre: +1 for smoothing. Before bumping quota, confirm global capacity — don't want to impact other tenants. Also add short-term rate-limit headers so client sees Retry-After. We have a rollout CLI: 
```
redwoodctl tenant update --id lumina --rate-smoothing=true --smoothing-window=10
redwoodctl tenant quota bump --id lumina --rpm +500 --reason "midnight batch mitigation"
```

maria_support: I kicked off the first command and pinged Lumina to deploy client-side backoff patch with jittered delays.

deploy-bot: Executed: `redwoodctl tenant update --id lumina --rate-smoothing=true --smoothing-window=10` at 2026-03-15T00:12:40Z — status: success.

maria_support: After smoothing enabled, partial improvement: spike peak down to ~1.1k RPM and 429 window shortened to ~3m. Customer still needs to patch their retries.

alex_dev: For long-term prevention: recommend they move batch to use server-side bulk endpoints (one request with multiple items) or use the scheduled tokenized fanout helper we provide (`/v1/bulk-enqueue`) which has internal rate-smoothing. Ticket dev-assist if they need migration help.

sam_sre: Action items:
- sam_sre: verify no global capacity impact, watch next 3 midnights, finish checking proxy logs (owner).
- jenny_prod: confirm quota bump holdback removed after client rollout (owner).
- maria_support: follow up with LuminaPay support engineering, get ETA for client patch + confirm they respect Retry-After (owner).

maria_support: Filed follow-up with Lumina: they will release a jitter+backoff patch by tomorrow 09:00 PT and limit parallelism to 100 per container. I'll update here when done. :thumbsup:

sam_sre: Good. If it reoccurs after client patch, we'll capture a minute-by-minute token-bucket trace and consider adding per-tenant pre-warming windows for scheduled jobs. For now closing as mitigated with smoothing + patch in flight.

maria_support: Marking as `handed-off-to-customer` and will close thread after confirmation.
